pricing.title: Pay as you go
pricing.subtitle: Each message is charged by the tokens actually used and the price of the model you pick, from your prepaid wallet.
pricing.topup: Top up via VietQR, minimum {min}. No free trial credit.

account.q: How do I get an account?
account.a: Accounts are issued by the admin, or you register with an invite code from a referrer.

cost.q: How much does one invitation cost?
cost.a: You pay per message and model used. The chat always shows the session cost and your wallet balance.

expiry.q: How long does the link last?
expiry.a: Pick 3, 7, 10 or 30 days. Expired links show "Invitation expired"; data is kept 15 more days then deleted. You can extend (paid).

edit.a: Yes. Open "My pages" to keep chatting or edit the form — the link stays the same.

images.a: Drag photos into the chat or the form. Up to 30 photos per page, auto-compressed.

refund.q: What if I run out of balance?
refund.a: The chat box locks, the session and preview are kept. Top up and continue.

cta.title: Ready for the big day?
cta.subtitle: A few messages and your invitation is ready to send to family and friends.
